summary.en: United Therapeutics combines pulmonary medicines and new-indication filings with gene-edited organ transplantation programs. Treprostinil and ralinepag are its principal near-term regulatory opportunities.
summary.zh: United Therapeutics 将肺部药物和新适应症申报,与基因编辑器官移植项目相结合。Treprostinil 和 ralinepag 是其近期主要的监管机会。

ind.en: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis; also Phase 3 progressive pulmonary fibrosis
ind.zh: 特发性肺纤维化;另有进行性肺纤维化 III 期

next.zh: FDA 决定,4 月 26 日

target.zh: 前列环素 IP 受体激动剂

next.zh: FDA 决定,6 月 24 日

watch.en: IPF and ralinepag FDA decisions are expected in April and June 2027; TETON-PPF results in H2 2027.
watch.zh: IPF 和 ralinepag 的 FDA 决定预计分别在 2027 年 4 月和 6 月作出;TETON-PPF 结果预计在 2027 年下半年公布。

watch.en: Ralinepag approval requires resolution of deficiencies at API supplier ScinoPharm.
watch.zh: Ralinepag 的获批需要解决原料药供应商 ScinoPharm 的缺陷问题。

watch.en: Settlements permit Orenitram generics from June and December 2027, subject to earlier-entry conditions.
watch.zh: 和解协议允许 Orenitram 仿制药自 2027 年 6 月和 12 月起上市,但需满足提前进入的条件。

watch.en: Tyvaso generated $503.8 million of $832.5 million Q3 revenue.
watch.zh: Tyvaso 贡献了第三季度 $832.5 million 收入中的 $503.8 million。

gaps: Xenografts use modality other; their targets and conventional numeric phases are not applicable or not established.
